findings.description: Reentrancy in stake(): external calls _syncBudget()->dispatcherHook.pull() (306) and stakedToken.safeTransferFrom (445); state vars committedDebt/rewardBudget/rewardRate/windowEnd written after via _safePay and tail _recomputeSchedule (455). Cross-function reentrancy on rewardBudget/committedDebt. NOTE: stake is nonReentrant (OZ ReentrancyGuard) and dispatcherHook is owner-configured trusted state; ERC1155 safeTransferFrom callback fires after the guard is set.

Reentrancy in unstake(): external calls _syncBudget()->dispatcherHook.pull() (306) and stakedToken.safeTransferFrom (471); committedDebt/rewardBudget/totalStaked/user.amount/user.rewardDebt and tail _recomputeSchedule state written after. unstake is nonReentrant; hook is trusted owner state.
Reentrancy in claim(): external call _syncBudget()->dispatcherHook.pull() (306); committedDebt/rewardBudget written after via _safePay (484). claim is nonReentrant; hook is trusted owner state.

Reentrancy in _syncBudget(): external call dispatcherHook.pull() (306); rewardBudget/rewardRate/windowEnd written after via _recomputeSchedule (308). Internal; only reachable through nonReentrant stake/unstake/claim or onlyOwner pullAndRefresh.
Benign reentrancy in claim(): user.rewardDebt written after _syncBudget()->dispatcherHook.pull(). nonReentrant-guarded.

Event NudgePaid (296) emitted after external nftMinter.mint() loop (281). NOTE: batchMint is whenNotPaused but NOT nonReentrant; it interleaves external calls (mint loop, nudge safeTransfer, refund safeTransfer) with a balance snapshot taken before the loop. Event-ordering only per this detector, but the absence of a reentrancy guard on the only fund-moving entrypoint is worth a manual look.
Events Pulled (310) and ScheduleRecomputed (424) emitted after dispatcherHook.pull() external call. Event-ordering only; nonReentrant on callers.
Return value of INFTMinterV2.configs(_dispatcherIndex) partially ignored (only .dispatcher consumed). Intentional tuple destructuring; benign.

Return value of nftMinter.mint(_dispatcherIndex, recipient) ignored inside the mint loop (the minted token id / amount is discarded). Aderyn flags the same site as unchecked-return. Mint reverts on failure so success is implied, but the discarded return means batchMint cannot relay minted ids to the caller.
Return value of nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex) partially ignored (only .price and .growthBasisPoints consumed). Intentional tuple destructuring; benign.
Local nudgeAmount declared uninitialized; relies on the 0 default and is only assigned when the nudge gate (count>=nudgeSize && token set) passes. Intentional (0 = no nudge); benign.

External call nftMinter.mint() inside a for-loop bounded by caller-supplied count. This is the core batch-minter design (story-009). Unbounded count is a caller-funded gas/DoS-on-self consideration, not a protocol DoS; flag for the gas/loop-bound manual lens.

block.timestamp comparisons (<=lastRewardTime, elapsed window cap at min(now,windowEnd)). Load-bearing time math: accrual settled between lastRewardTime and min(now,windowEnd). Kept per time-driven-protocol policy.
windowEnd = block.timestamp + runway derives the depletion deadline from current time. Core runway math; kept per time-driven-protocol policy.
Comparison amount>committedDebt (flagged under timestamp detector via call graph). No direct timestamp dependence; benign.
Comparison pending>committedDebt (flagged via call graph). No direct timestamp dependence; benign.
Flagged via call graph (no direct block.timestamp comparison in unstake body beyond the inherited accrual path). Benign.
block.timestamp>lastRewardTime and end=min(now,windowEnd) used to forward-simulate accrual in the view. Mirrors _updatePool; kept per time-driven-protocol policy.
block.timestamp>=windowEnd gates whether the live rate is reported as 0 (runway depleted). Kept per time-driven-protocol policy.
block.timestamp comparisons forward-simulate the next _updatePool for the debt view. Kept per time-driven-protocol policy.

State change after external call (Aderyn HIGH): stakedToken.safeTransferFrom at 445 precedes user.amount/totalStaked/user.rewardDebt writes and the tail _recomputeSchedule. Same root cause as SLITHER-001 reentrancy-no-eth. Mitigant: stake() is nonReentrant and the staked token is the owner-pinned ERC1155; severity-classifier should weigh the guard.
Return value of nftMinter.mint() not used. Duplicate of SLITHER-009 unused-return at the same site.
Loop counter `i` in the mint loop declared without explicit initializer (defaults to 0). Idiomatic Solidity; benign. Distinct from SLITHER-011 (nudgeAmount).
